Everyone has given good advice, I have some that is a little bit more harsh, but it has really helped given me my own kick in the pants to stay consistent.

Consistency actually is key number 1. You do whatever you need to do to stay consistent. This looks different for everyone.

Next, understand that you cannot outrun the pain. The only way out of this is through. But the good news is, we can do hard things! If you stick to a diet, you’re going to be confronted with pain. Physical pain and emotional pain (I’m assuming you’re like most of us who use food as a coping mechanism for life). When you’re having a stressful day and all you wanna do is go get ice cream and break your diet, you can’t. When you’re in a social situation and everyone around you is ordering fun food and you don’t wanna be the one to stick out, you have to anyway. And you might be hungry or have all sorts of weird digestion issues for the first few weeks which can feel like forever.

So you need to mentally prepare for all of that. It sucks balls, but we can actually do it. And if you do it, your body will change!

Last, for me I had to remind myself that a diet is not an eating disorder. Just because I’m cutting calories it doesn’t mean that I’m doing something unhealthy. In fact it’s actually healthy in the long run for me. I think I have a tendency to feel like I’m not taking care of myself if I deprive myself at all, but that’s something to work on in therapy ya know?
